title: Phil Wilson's mad antics in London
summary: Wilson was erratic, and in London staged mock manuscript chaos for an interviewer.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Oh, that's great. Okay, do you recall the people that were kind of catalysts of that kind of --
Well, I think the ones I mentioned were the strongest ones, I think, to some degree. But there were people that came in and out of the band.
Yeah. I thought that Phil Wilson was kind of a nut.
Oh, yeah, he was. I didn't always approve of some of his -- because he was not in his right mind a great deal of the time.

And that kind of humor sometimes loses me. In order to be really a wild comic, you must have all your faculties going for you, not some of them. So I think the best thing he ever did, but it didn't really prove anything, was when he was to be interviewed in London and he immediately went out and got all kinds of manuscript paper and started writing mad lines and having the music all over the floor, so that when this newspaper guy came in for an interview, he would witness this --
Yeah, because especially in view of the
fact he was not writing anything for the band.
He'd not been allowed that great experiment. Later, he did.
